name: NavTools AI

sources.title: Homepage — daily-updated AI directory with Featured/Sponsored band and rankings
Submit page — Basic $0 (30–90 day review), Fast Track $29.9 (48h + 7-day homepage feature), Growth Pro $149 (24h + 15-day placements)

conditions: Free Basic tier exists but carries a 30–90 day review queue; paid tiers ($29.9 / $149 one-time) jump to 48h / 24h review plus featured placements
requirements: AI-powered tools and services 'that provide genuine value to users' — chatbots, image generators, writing assistants, productivity tools, etc.
Quick Submit needs only Tool Name (2–50 chars), Website URL, and Contact Email — NavTools generates the listing content for you
'Add Details Yourself' mode lets you write the listing copy when exact wording matters
Manual review for all tiers; priority goes to paid plans
preparation: Tool name, website URL, and contact email (minimum viable submission)
If writing your own listing: description, category, pricing details, logo/screenshots
Decision on tier: free (30–90d) vs $29.9 Fast Track vs $149 Growth Pro
workflow: Choose Submission Type: Basic ($0), Fast Track ($29.9 one-time), or Growth Pro ($149 one-time)
Choose Quick Submit (3 fields; they generate content) or Add Details Yourself
Submit and wait for the review window of the chosen tier
Approved tools get a directory listing; paid tiers get labelled featured placement
watchFor: The free 30–90 day queue is long — paid tiers exist primarily to skip it
Quick Submit lets them write your listing — check the generated copy for accuracy after it goes live
Featured placements are labelled 'Sponsored' — organic and paid sections are distinct
Directory includes NSFW categories (AI Girlfriend, Dirty Talking) — consider brand adjacency
Login link exists but Quick Submit appears to not require an account
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a detail page in the NavTools directory and category listing after the chosen tier's review window
unknowns: Whether Basic-tier listing links are dofollow
Whether the generated listing can be edited after publication without paying
